text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Sylvan Cove aiming to flip to private VPC on Friday. Items holding: KMS cross-account acceptance, audit log egress path to our collector, and service-account IAM least-privilege. They mentioned renewal concern if cutover has >1hr downtime. Any immediate blockers?

raj_net: Networking status: TGW attachment in place. Need one more security-group rule to allow outbound 443 to collector.redwood.internal and 443 to s3.amazonaws.com. Also requested we support VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) instead of NAT for lower latency.

olivia_security: KMS: we generated a customer-managed key alias: alias/redwood/sylvan-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222233334444:key/sylv-999). Their cloud-admin must add our logging role arn:aws:iam::555566667777:role/redwood-logging to the key policy. They pushed back on our proposed rotation window (30d) citing internal policy 90d.

duncan_sre: For egress: if they use S3 endpoint + parallel uploader, average latency to object ready is ~28s in staging. NAT adds ~10-15s. Recommend endpoints to meet their <60s SLA.

sylvan_cloudadmin: Can you share the exact policy snippet we need to apply? We're not comfortable granting Decrypt across roles without scoping. Also can we limit use to the logging key to only PutObject calls?

olivia_security: Posted minimal policy snippet below for their IAM team. It scopes to the specific key and limits actions to encryption operations used by our uploader: 

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLoggingRole",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555566667777:role/redwood-logging"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222233334444:key/sylv-999",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

olivia_security: Note: we removed Decrypt from cross-account to address their concern; our uploader can manage envelope keys within Redwood account and only needs Encrypt/GenerateDataKey on their key. This design requires our collector to hold Decrypt rights in our account KMS and rotate securely.

maria_cs: That's a helpful compromise. Sylvan, is that acceptable? If not, we need to escalate. Renewal note: finance flagged that if we cannot meet their security bar without addendum, renewal may slip.

sylvan_cloudadmin: That policy looks better. Two follow-ups: 1) can you document the flow end-to-end (who holds Decrypt, how rotation works), 2) can we get a short threat model note? We'll review with security.

duncan_sre: I'll drop a short diagram + sequence and include the uploader role responsibilities. Also recommend S3 endpoint to reduce latency.

deploybot: Dry-run deployment scheduled: 2026-04-02T15:30:00Z. Staging run results: S3 endpoint + uploader = median 26s, S3 via NAT = 40s.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) @olivia_security send the threat model + rotation doc (due EOD), 2) @duncan_sre publish sequence diagram and recommended config (due tomorrow), 3) @raj_net add the SG rule and confirm endpoint ARN, 4) Sylvan to confirm KMS policy acceptance (please reply when applied). I'll tag renewal "elevated" until we see KMS policy applied and successful dry-run in customer account.

olivia_security: Will send docs now to sylvan-cloudadmin.

raj_net: Security group rule added: sg-0f1e2d3c, VPC endpoint created: vpce-0a1b2c3d. Shared via DM.

sylvan_cloudadmin: We applied the key policy change in our account (arn:aws:iam::555566667777:role/redwood-logging allowed Encrypt/GenerateDataKey). Running a canary PUT now.

duncan_sre: Canary result: PutObject into sylvan bucket -> collector acknowledged, object available in Redwood S3 in 33s. Marking dry-run PASS.

maria_cs: Great — moving renewal from "elevated" -> "monitor" until rotation schedule confirmed. Closing when rotation cadence agreed. :thumbsup:
